```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
windowsFonts(kai = windowsFont("Microsoft JhengHei"))
par(family = "kai", mar = c(5, 6, 4, 10)) 

path <- "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/花蓮縣公車.csv"
data <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


date1 <- as.Date(data$資料代表日期.yyyy.MM.dd.)
data$year <- year(date1)

data_year <- data %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025))


year_total <- table(data_year$year)

year_value <- as.numeric(names(year_total))
ride_count <- as.numeric(year_total)

routes <- c("301","302","303","305","307","308","309","310","311","1123")

data_route <- data_year %>%
  filter(搭乘路線名稱 %in% routes)


route_count <- table(data_route$year, data_route$搭乘路線名稱)

route_count <- route_count[, routes, drop=FALSE]


route_percent <- prop.table(route_count, 1)


route_height <- route_percent * ride_count

png("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/112年至114年太魯閣客運運量趨勢1.png",
    width=12,
    height=6,
    units="in",
    res=300)

bp <- barplot(
  t(route_height),
  beside=TRUE,
  col=gray.colors(length(routes)),
  ylim=c(0, max(ride_count)*1.2),
  xlab="年份",
  ylab="搭乘次數",
  main="112年至114年太魯閣客運運量趨勢1"
)


year_center <- colMeans(matrix(bp, nrow=length(routes)))
axis(1, at=year_center, labels=c("2023","2024","2025"))


text(
  bp,
  as.vector(t(route_height)) + max(ride_count)*0.02,
  labels=paste0(round(as.vector(t(route_percent))*100,1),"%"),
  cex=0.6
)


lines(
  year_center,
  ride_count,
  type="o",
  pch=16,
  lwd=2,
  col="black"
)


text(
  year_center,
  ride_count,
  labels=ride_count,
  pos=3,
  cex=0.9
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend=c(routes, "搭乘次數"),
  fill=c(gray.colors(length(routes)), NA),
  border=c(rep(NA, length(routes)), "black"),
  lty=c(rep(0, length(routes)), 1),
  pch=c(rep(15, length(routes)), 16),
  cex=0.7
)

png("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/112年至114年太魯閣客運運量趨勢1.png",
    width = 12,
    height = 6,
    units = "in",
    res = 300)

dev.off()
```
